newsitem.title: USA: Loral in $350 million satellite contract.
newsitem.headline: Loral in $350 million satellite contract.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd's Space Systems/Loral unit said Monday it entered into a contract with P.T. Pasifik Satelit Nusantara of Jakarta, Indonesia, to build one high-powered satellite and provide long lead parts for an optional second satellite.
It said it has options to provide five additional satellites.
In a statement, Loral said the project, valued at approximately $350 million, extends the company's position in the worldwide market for high power satellites.

Under the contract which will provide multimedia and telephony services throughout Asia, Space Systems/Loral will deliver one satellite on-orbit on a Russian Proton rocket in early 1999 to a position of 134 degrees east longitude or 118 degrees east longitude. Alcatel Espace will work in association with Space Systems/Loral to provide the communication repeater module for this satellite, known as M2A, which P.T. Pasifik Satelit Nusantara will use to further develop its Multi-Media Satellite System.
